entities.name: Fujiwara no Kanesuke
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Fujiwara no Kanesuke , also known as the Riverbank Middle Counselor , was a middle Heian-period waka poet and Japanese nobleman. He is designated as a member of the Thirty-six Poetry Immortals.
